evidence: Has the Mempool label and modifies mempool ordering logic in src/txmempool.cpp and src/txgraph.cpp.
rationale: Reduces mempool lock contention by replacing O(N log N) sorting with an O(N) chunk index traversal in CTxMemPool::GetSortedScoreWithTopology(). Benchmarks demonstrate significant performance improvements under lock, with getrawmempool execution dropping from 99 ms to 24 ms for 60k transactions.
